newsitem.title: UK: Safeway to open London stores overnight.
newsitem.headline: Safeway to open London stores overnight.

text.p: Britain's third largest supermarket group Safeway Plc will open two of its London stores overnight on Fridays "to make...shopping easier."
Safeway's Brent Cross shopping centre store will open for 40 hours from 0800 GMT on February 28 to 2400 GMT on March 1 and continue these hours every Friday, the company said in a statement.
The stores were previously open from 0800 GMT to 2200 GMT on Mondays to Saturdays and from 1000 GMT to 1600 GMT on Sundays.
Safeway said its Camden, north London, store will follow with similar hours in March.
Both stores will also open until 2400 GMT on all other days of the week except Sunday.
Safeway said the initiative could create 100 new part-time jobs.
